```{r setup}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(XML)
library(ggbreak)
library(tibble)
library(ggh4x)


# This document is executed with its own folder (stats/) as the working
# directory, which is Quarto/knitr's default -- hence the "../" prefixes.
CSV_PATH   <- "../data/walk_stats.csv"
IMG_DIR    <- "../images/stats"
JSON_PATH  <- "../data/walk_stats_summary.json"
GPX_PATH   <- "../data/coastal_walk.gpx"
COAST_SF   <- "../data/uk_lowtide_simple.shp"

dir.create(IMG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Reading the log

`walk_stats.csv` is whatever comes straight out of an "export sheet as CSV" from
the trip spreadsheet — title row, formula columns, the lot. This document only
trusts the *raw* input columns (date, swims, spend by category, distance) and
recomputes everything else itself, so nothing here depends on a spreadsheet
formula being right.

```{r read-data}
raw_lines <- read_lines(CSV_PATH)
header_row <- which(startsWith(raw_lines, "date,"))[1]
if (is.na(header_row)) {
  stop("Could not find a header row starting with 'date' in ", CSV_PATH)
}

df_raw <- read_csv(CSV_PATH, skip = header_row - 1, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Matched by pattern rather than a literal "£" character: R's source
# parser can mis-handle a non-ASCII literal under some locales, so this
# keeps column-matching correct regardless of the runtime environment.
find_col <- function(names_vec, pattern) {
  hits <- names_vec[grepl(pattern, names_vec)]
  if (length(hits) != 1) {
    stop("Expected exactly one column matching '", pattern, "', found ",
         length(hits), ": ", paste(hits, collapse = ", "))
  }
  hits[1]
}

nm <- names(df_raw)

fixed_col_map <- c(
  date              = find_col(nm, "date$"),
  day               = find_col(nm, "day$"),
  country           = find_col(nm, "county$"),
  swims             = find_col(nm, "swims$"),
  spend_accom       = find_col(nm, "£_accom$"),
  spend_groceries   = find_col(nm, "£_groceries$"),
  spend_eating_out  = find_col(nm, "£_eord_out$"),
  spend_boats       = find_col(nm, "£_boats$"),
  spend_drinks      = find_col(nm, "£_alcohol$"),
  spend_gear        = find_col(nm, "£_gear$"),
  distance_km       = find_col(nm, "distance_km$")
)

# any column following the <brand>_bought / <brand>_for convention is picked
# up automatically -- add a new beer to the CSV and it appears here with
# no code changes needed
beer_cols <- nm[grepl("_(bought|for)$", nm)]

df <- df_raw %>%
  rename(!!!fixed_col_map) %>%
  select(all_of(names(fixed_col_map)), all_of(beer_cols)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date, format = "%d %b %Y"),
    across(starts_with("spend_"), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)),
    across(all_of(beer_cols), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)),
    swims = replace_na(as.numeric(swims), 0),
    distance_km = replace_na(as.numeric(distance_km), 0),
    beers_drank      = rowSums(across(matches("_bought$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    beers_bought_for = rowSums(across(matches("_for$")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    trip_day   = row_number(),
    gap_before = c(FALSE, diff(date) > 1)
  )

gpx_parsed <- htmlTreeParse(GPX_PATH, useInternalNodes = TRUE)
coords <- xpathSApply(doc = gpx_parsed, path = "//trkpt", fun = xmlAttrs) 

df_gpx <- data.frame( 
  lat = as.numeric(coords["lat", ]), 
  lon = as.numeric(coords["lon", ]) 
)

gpx_sf <- st_as_sf(df_gpx, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(27700)

uk_coastline <- read_sf(COAST_SF) |> st_transform(27700)
coast_union <- st_union(uk_coastline)

df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(gpx_sf, coast_union))


```

```{r create-ax-breaks}
gap_ranges <- df %>%
  mutate(prev_date = lag(date)) %>%
  filter(gap_before) %>%
  transmute(gap_start = prev_date + 1, gap_end = date - 1)

add_date_breaks <- function(p, gap_ranges) {
  if (nrow(gap_ranges) == 0) return(p)
  breaks_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(gap_ranges)), function(i) {
    print(c(gap_ranges$gap_start[i], gap_ranges$gap_end[i]))
    scale_x_break(c(gap_ranges$gap_start[i], gap_ranges$gap_end[i]), scales = "fixed")
  })
  Reduce(`+`, breaks_list, init = p)
}

tick_breaks <- seq(
  min(df$date),
  max(df$date),
  by = 3
)
```


`r nrow(df)` days logged, `r min(df$date)` to `r max(df$date)`.

## Derived columns

7-day averages use a right-aligned window that shortens at the start of the
trip (day 3's "7-day average" is really just the average of days 1–3) —
matching the convention already used in the spreadsheet.

```{r derive}
roll_mean_right <- function(x, width = 7) {
  vapply(seq_along(x), function(i) mean(x[max(1, i - width + 1):i]), numeric(1))
}

roll_sd_right <- function(x, width = 7) {
  vapply(seq_along(x), function(i) sd(x[max(1, i - width + 1):i]), numeric(1))
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    spend_total             = spend_accom + spend_groceries + spend_eating_out +
                               spend_boats + spend_drinks + spend_gear,
    swims_7day_avg          = roll_mean_right(swims),
    swims_3day_avg          = roll_mean_right(swims, 3),
    distance_7day_avg       = roll_mean_right(distance_km),
    spend_7day_avg          = roll_mean_right(spend_total),
    distance_cumulative     = cumsum(distance_km),
    swims_cumulative        = cumsum(swims),
    spend_cumulative        = cumsum(spend_total),
  )
```

## Headline numbers

These get written out as JSON for the site's stat cards, so the numbers on
the page match this report exactly.

```{r summary}
summary_stats <- list(
  total_days              = nrow(df),
  date_start               = as.character(min(df$date)),
  date_end                  = as.character(max(df$date)),
  total_distance_km          = round(sum(df$distance_km), 1),
  avg_distance_km              = round(mean(df$distance_km), 1),
  total_swims                    = sum(df$swims),
  avg_swims_per_day               =round(mean(df$swims),1),
  total_spend                      = round(sum(df$spend_total), 2),
  avg_spend_per_day                  = round(mean(df$spend_total), 2),
  avg_coastal_distance_m              = round(mean(df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m),1),
  max_coastal_distance_m               = round(max(df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m),1),
  spend_by_category = list(
    accom      = round(sum(df$spend_accom), 2),
    groceries   = round(sum(df$spend_groceries), 2),
    eating_out   = round(sum(df$spend_eating_out), 2),
    boats         = round(sum(df$spend_boats), 2),
    drinks         = round(sum(df$spend_drinks), 2),
    gear            = round(sum(df$spend_gear), 2)
  ),
  generated_at = as.character(Sys.time())
)


write_json(summary_stats, JSON_PATH, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
```

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Total distance | `r summary_stats$total_distance_km` km |
| Average per day | `r summary_stats$avg_distance_km` km |
| Total swims | `r summary_stats$total_swims` |
| Total spend | £`r summary_stats$total_spend` |
| Average spend / day | £`r summary_stats$avg_spend_per_day` |

```{r chart-distance}
p_distance_unbroken <- ggplot(df, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = distance_km), fill = COL_DISTANCE, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_line(aes(y = distance_7day_avg), colour = COL_DISTANCE, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(gap_ranges$gap_start)+0.7,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = alpha("gray30",0.5)
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(gap_ranges$gap_end)-0.8,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = alpha("gray30",0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Distance walked per day", x = NULL, y = "km",
       caption = "Line = 7-day average") +
  site_theme

p_dist_broken <- add_date_breaks(p_distance_unbroken, gap_ranges)

p_distance <- p_dist_broken +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = tick_breaks,
    labels = function(x) {
      format(as.Date(x, origin = "1970-01-01"), "%d %b")
    }
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0
    ),
    axis.text.x.top = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(IMG_DIR, "distance_over_time.png"), p_distance,
       width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
print(p_distance)
```

## Spend

```{r spending-chart}
region_order <- df %>%
  distinct(country, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  pull(country)

spend_long <- df %>%
  select(country, spend_accom, spend_groceries, spend_eating_out, spend_boats, spend_drinks, spend_gear) %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "category", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(category = recode(category,
    spend_accom = "Accommodation", spend_groceries = "Groceries",
    spend_eating_out = "Eating out", spend_boats = "Boats",
    spend_drinks = "Alcohol", spend_gear = "Gear"
  ))

region_category_totals <- spend_long %>%
  group_by(country, category) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(country = factor(country, levels = region_order))

region_avg <- df %>%
  count(country, name = "days_in_region") %>%
  left_join(spend_long %>% group_by(country) %>% summarise(total_spend = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "country") %>%
  mutate(avg_daily_spend = total_spend / days_in_region,
         label = paste0("avg £", round(avg_daily_spend, 1), "/day"),
         country = factor(country, levels = region_order))

region_x_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(region_avg$country, "\n(", region_avg$days_in_region, " days)"),
  as.character(region_avg$country)
)

p_spend <- ggplot(region_category_totals, aes(x = country, y = value, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, colour = "white", linewidth = 0) +
  geom_text(data = region_avg, aes(x = country, y = total_spend, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.4, size = 3, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = region_x_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "£"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Spend by region", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  site_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 15, b = 5.5, l = 5.5),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank() ,
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line( size=.1, color="black" )) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

ggsave(file.path(IMG_DIR, "spend_by_region.png"), p_spend, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 200)
print(p_spend)
```

```{r sea_temperatures}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

my_spots_json <- read_json("../data/spots.json")

library(purrr)

camp_coords <- map_dfr(my_spots_json, ~ {
  
  # Extract number of nights from description
  nights <- stringr::str_extract(.x$description, "(?<=nights=)\\d+")
  nights <- ifelse(is.na(nights), 1, as.integer(nights))
  
  tibble(
    name = .x$name,
    date = as.Date(.x$date) + 0:(nights - 1),
    lat  = .x$lat,
    lng  = .x$lng,
    nights = nights
  )
})

get_sst_history <- function(name, lat, lng, campdate) {
  url <- "https://marine-api.open-meteo.com/v1/marine"
  
  resp <- GET(url, query = list(
    latitude = lat,
    longitude = lng,
    hourly = "sea_surface_temperature",
    start_date = campdate,
    end_date = campdate,
    timezone = "auto"
  ))
  
  data <- fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  
  if (!is.null(data$error) && isTRUE(data$error)) {
    warning(paste0("API error for '", name, "' (", campdate, "): ", data$reason))
    return(tibble(name = name, date = as.Date(campdate), sst_mean = NA_real_))
  }
  
  df <- data.frame(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(data$hourly$time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M", tz = "UTC"),
    sst = data$hourly$sea_surface_temperature
  )
  
  df %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    summarise(sst_mean = mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(name = name, .before = 1)
}

sst_history <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(camp_coords)), function(i) {
  get_sst_history(
    camp_coords$name[i],
    camp_coords$lat[i],
    camp_coords$lng[i],
    camp_coords$date[i]
  )
}))

```


```{r weather-history}
get_weather_history <- function(name, lat, lng, campdate) {
  url <- "https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive"
  
  resp <- GET(url, query = list(
    latitude = lat,
    longitude = lng,
    hourly = "temperature_2m,precipitation",
    start_date = campdate,
    end_date = campdate,
    timezone = "auto"
  ))
  
  data <- fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  
  if (!is.null(data$error) && isTRUE(data$error)) {
    warning(paste0("API error for '", name, "' (", campdate, "): ", data$reason))
    return(tibble(name = name, date = as.Date(campdate), temp_mean = NA_real_, precip_total = NA_real_))
  }
  
  df <- data.frame(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(data$hourly$time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M", tz = "UTC"),
    temp = data$hourly$temperature_2m,
    precip = data$hourly$precipitation
  )
  
  
  df %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    summarise(
      temp_mean = mean(temp[8:20], na.rm = TRUE),
      precip_total = sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(name = name, .before = 1)
}

weather_history <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(camp_coords)), function(i) {
  get_weather_history(
    camp_coords$name[i],
    camp_coords$lat[i],
    camp_coords$lng[i],
    camp_coords$date[i]
  )
}))


max_temp   <- max(c(weather_history$temp_mean, sst_history$sst_mean), na.rm = TRUE)
max_precip <- max(weather_history$precip_total, na.rm = TRUE)
scale_factor <- if (max_precip > 0) max_temp / max_precip else 1
sec_formula <- as.formula(paste0("~ . / ", scale_factor))

weather_history <- weather_history %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(temp_mean_smooth = roll_mean_right(temp_mean))

sst_history <- sst_history %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(sst_mean_smooth = roll_mean_right(sst_mean))

# swim days, for the rug at the bottom
swim_days <- df %>% filter(swims > 0) %>% select(date)

# air/sea temp on the same date grid, for the ribbon between them
temp_ribbon <- weather_history %>%
  select(date, air = temp_mean_smooth) %>%
  inner_join(sst_history %>% select(date, sea = sst_mean_smooth), by = "date")

p_weather_unbroken <- ggplot(weather_history, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = precip_total * scale_factor), fill = COL_SWIMS_dark, alpha = 0.25, width = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = temp_ribbon, aes(x = date, ymin = pmin(air, sea), ymax = pmax(air, sea)),
              fill = COL_SWIMS, alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = temp_mean), colour = COL_SWIMS_light, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = temp_mean_smooth, colour = "Air temp"), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_line(data = sst_history, aes(x = date, y = sst_mean), colour = COL_SWIMS_darker, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = sst_history, aes(x = date, y = sst_mean_smooth, colour = "Sea temp"), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(gap_ranges$gap_start)+0.7,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = alpha("gray30",0.5)
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(gap_ranges$gap_end)-0.8,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = alpha("gray30",0.5)
  ) +
```

```{r chart-swims-weather-correlation}
weather_history <- weather_history %>%
  left_join(
    sst_history %>% select(date, sst = sst_mean),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df %>% select(date, swims, swims_3day_avg),
    by = "date"
  )

input_swims <- "swims_3day_avg"

df_corr <- weather_history %>%
  transmute(
    input_swims = .data[[input_swims]],
    temp_mean,
    sst,
    precip_total
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(temp_mean, sst, precip_total),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(recode(variable,
    temp_mean    = "Air temp (°C)",
    sst          = "Sea temp (°C)",
    precip_total = "Precipitation (mm)"
  ), levels = c("Air temp (°C)", "Sea temp (°C)", "Precipitation (mm)")))

cor_labels <- df_corr %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(input_swims)) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(input_swims, value, use = "complete.obs"),
    x = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(input_swims, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("r = ", round(r, 2)))

variable_colours <- c(
  "Air temp (°C)"      = COL_SWIMS_light,
  "Sea temp (°C)"      = COL_SWIMS_darker,
  "Precipitation (mm)" = COL_SWIMS_dark
)

build_swims_weather_plot <- function(ncol_facets = NULL, nrow_facets = NULL) {
  ggplot(df_corr, aes(x = value, y = input_swims, colour = variable)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 2.6) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = cor_labels,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3.2,
      colour = "grey30",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(
      x = list(
        variable == "Precipitation (mm)" ~ scale_x_continuous(trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1))
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = variable_colours,
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of swims",
      title = "Swims vs weather conditions"
    ) +
    site_theme
}


p_swims_weather_wide    <- build_swims_weather_plot(nrow_facets = 1)
p_swims_weather_stacked <- build_swims_weather_plot(ncol_facets = 1)

ggsave(file.path(IMG_DIR, "swims_vs_weather_wide.png"), p_swims_weather_wide,
       width = 18, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
ggsave(file.path(IMG_DIR, "swims_vs_weather_stacked.png"), p_swims_weather_stacked,
       width = 4.5, height = 10, dpi = 220)

print(p_swims_weather_wide)
print(p_swims_weather_stacked)
```

```{r coastal-distance-map}
#| echo: false

n <- nrow(df_gpx)

segments_sf <- st_sf(
  dist = pmax((df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m[-n] + df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m[-1]) / 2, 1),
  geometry = st_sfc(
    lapply(1:(n - 1), function(i) {
      st_linestring(rbind(
        c(df_gpx$lon[i],     df_gpx$lat[i]),
        c(df_gpx$lon[i + 1], df_gpx$lat[i + 1])
      ))
    }),
    crs = 4326
  )
)

pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "viridis", domain = log10(segments_sf$dist))

m <- leaflet(segments_sf) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolylines(color = ~pal(log10(dist)), weight = 4, opacity = 0.9) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal, values = ~log10(dist),
    title = "Distance to coast (m)",
    labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) round(10^x))
  )

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(m, file.path(IMG_DIR, "coastal_map.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)
```

```{r coast_dist_sd}
df_gpx$point_index <- seq_len(nrow(df_gpx))
smooth_factor <- 7
window <- max(2, ceiling(nrow(df_gpx) / smooth_factor))  # guard against width < 2

df_gpx$roll_mean_coast_dist <- roll_mean_right(df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m, window)
df_gpx$roll_sd_coast_dist   <- roll_sd_right(df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m, window)

eps <- 0.5  # keeps the ribbon's lower bound off zero for the log10 axis
#df_gpx$roll_lower <- pmax(df_gpx$roll_mean_coast_dist - df_gpx$roll_sd_coast_dist, eps)
#df_gpx$roll_upper <- df_gpx$roll_mean_coast_dist + df_gpx$roll_sd_coast_dist

# trying with log means and sd
log_dist <- log10(pmax(df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m, eps))
roll_mean_log <- roll_mean_right(log_dist, window)
roll_sd_log   <- roll_sd_right(log_dist, window)

df_gpx$roll_mean_coast_dist <- 10^roll_mean_log
df_gpx$roll_lower <- 10^(roll_mean_log - roll_sd_log)
df_gpx$roll_upper <- 10^(roll_mean_log + roll_sd_log)


draw_key_linebox <- function(data, params, size) {
  grid::grobTree(
    grid::rectGrob(gp = grid::gpar(fill = scales::alpha("steelblue", 0.3), col = NA)),
    grid::segmentsGrob(x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 0.5, y1 = 0.5,
                       gp = grid::gpar(col = data$colour, lwd = data$linewidth * .pt))
  )
}

p_coastal_dist <- ggplot(df_gpx, aes(x = point_index)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = roll_lower, ymax = roll_upper, fill = "±1 SD"),
              alpha = 0.2, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = dist_to_coast_m, colour = "Raw"), linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = roll_mean_coast_dist, colour = "Rolling mean + sd"), linewidth = 0.6, key_glyph = draw_key_linebox) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Raw" = COL_SWIMS, "Rolling mean + sd" = COL_SWIMS_darker)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("±1 SD" = "steelblue")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")+
  labs(title = "Distance to the coast", x = "Track point", y = "Distance (m)",
       colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  site_theme +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, NA)) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.2),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.5, 'cm'),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white",0.7), colour = NA)
        )

ggsave(file.path(IMG_DIR, "coastal_distance_and_sd.png"), p_coastal_dist,
       width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
print(p_coastal_dist)
```


```{r coast_dist_distribution}
dist_positive <- df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m[df_gpx$dist_to_coast_m > 0]
breaks_coast_log <- 10^seq(log10(min(dist_positive)), log10(max(dist_positive)), length.out = 150)

p_hist_1 <- ggplot(df_gpx, aes(x = dist_to_coast_m)) +
  geom_histogram(breaks = breaks_coast_log, fill = COL_DISTANCE, alpha = 0.6, colour = COL_DISTANCE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000), labels = c("1", "10", "100", "1000")) +
  labs(title = "Coastal distance distribution", x = "Distance (m)", y = "Number of points") +
  site_theme

p_qqplot <- ggplot(mapping = aes(sample = log10(dist_positive))) +
  geom_qq(shape = 1, size = 0.5, stroke = 0.3, colour = "grey40", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_qq_line(colour = "red", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "LogNormal Q-Q", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 5, colour = "grey50"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey70"),
    #panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3),
    #plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

p_combined <- p_hist_1 +
  inset_element(p_qqplot, left = 0.05, bottom = 0.35, right = 0.42, top = 0.88)

ggsave(file.path(IMG_DIR, "coastal_distance_histogram_log.png"), p_combined,
       width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
print(p_combined)
```
